basic_info.description: Location, square footage, light and opportunity- 1633 Beach Street is back with a refreshed and elevated look. This three bedroom, three bath TIC is an ideal opportunity for condo conversion and expansion. The spacious formal living room has light from the north and east courtyard. The formal dining room is well appointed and leads to a sunny breakfast nook and updated kitchen with laundry room. The primary suite has a generous walk-in closet and bathroom with tub and shower. The secondary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and large window to the south. The third bedroom is en-suite and can also be used as an office or nursery. A large sunroom faces the southern backyard with two decks to the east and west. Included in the TIC upon condo conversion is exclusive use of the backyard. Property currently includes one car parking (which could be expanded into two) and the back of the garage which can be used as two store rooms or developed into auxiliary space. Don't miss this opportunity! TIC materials drafted by Lyssa Paul.
